requirement_sections: Specification > Handling of f-string debug expressions
tests.public_surface: public ast module only: ast.parse of an f-string debug expression and the col_offset of the implicit debug-text Constant node.
tests.rationale: PEP-701 gives f-string debug expressions accurate AST positions: the implicit debug-text Constant must start at the expression, not the opening brace. mutant_014 shifts its col_offset from the expression (3) to the brace (2); pre-PEP-701 the node carries the f-string's col_offset (0). Runtime debug-text output is unchanged, so the AST position is the discriminating signal.
